name: Apiro Icons
author: Fakhrul Alam

sections.description:
Apiro Icons integrates a collected set of free icons into the Elementor Icon Picker.

Features

  • Seamless integration into Elementor Icon Library.
  • Access to a collected set of free icons (Solid, Regular, and Brands styles).
  • High performance with local bundling and transient caching for icon lists.
  • Customizable CDN Base URL for custom asset delivery if desired.

3rd Party Services

By default, this plugin does not load any third-party services on the front-end, making it fully GPDR-compliant. All icon assets are bundled and loaded locally.

However, if you choose to configure a custom CDN under Settings:
* Service Name: Custom CDN Base URL (e.g. Vercel, jsDelivr, etc.)
* Purpose: Delivers icon CSS stylesheets (all.min.css) and webfont files (.woff2, .ttf) from your specified CDN.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the apiro-icons directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP file directly via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any page in Elementor, edit a widget containing an icon picker, and select from the Apiro Icons tabs.
sections.faq:
How do I use the icons in Elementor?

Open any Elementor widget with an Icon control, click the Icon Library, and choose any of the Apiro Icons tabs.

Can I use a custom CDN URL?

Yes! Navigate to Settings > Apiro Icons in your WordPress admin dashboard to set a custom CDN base URL.
